question: The Border-Gavaskar trophy is played between ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India and Australia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Border-Gavaskar Trophy** is a Test cricket series played between **India and Australia**.
 
• The trophy is named after two cricketing legends, **Allan Border** of Australia and **Sunil Gavaskar** of India.
 
• It was first contested during the **1996/97 cricket season** when India hosted Australia for a one-off Test match.
 
• The Border-Gavaskar Trophy is a **bilateral Test series**, and its matches are part of the **ICC World Test Championship** since its inception in 2019.
 
• India has dominated the Border-Gavaskar Trophy in recent years, including memorable series wins in Australia in **2018-19** and **2020-21**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allan Border:**

 
 
• Allan Border is a former Australian cricketer who captained the Australian team for most of the 1980s.
 
• He is regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in cricket history and was the first player to reach **11,000 Test runs**.
 
 
 
• **Sunil Gavaskar:**
 
 
• Sunil Gavaskar is a former Indian cricketer and one of the finest opening batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• He was the first player to score **10,000 Test runs** and held the record for most centuries in Test cricket (34) for many years.
 
 
 
• **Significant Matches:**
 
 
• The 2001 Kolkata Test (Eden Gardens) is one of the most iconic matches in the Border-Gavaskar Trophy, where India achieved a historic victory after following on.
 
• The 2020-21 series marked a remarkable comeback by India after being bowled out for **36 in Adelaide**, culminating in a series win at the Gabba, Brisbane.
 
 
 
• **ICC World Test Championship:**
 
 
• The Border-Gavaskar Trophy is now a part of the ICC World Test Championship, adding more significance to the series.
 
• The ICC World Test Championship aims to crown the best Test cricket team globally through a league format.
